create_UnCLIPScheduler: create an UnCLIPScheduler instance with custom num_train_timesteps and variance_type for the karlo unCLIP model
set_timesteps_UnCLIPScheduler: set the discrete inference timesteps on an UnCLIPScheduler before running the denoising loop
step_UnCLIPScheduler: step the UnCLIPScheduler to predict the previous sample by reversing the diffusion SDE from model output
add_noise_UnCLIPScheduler: add noise to original samples using the UnCLIPScheduler forward diffusion process at given timesteps
compute_betas_for_alpha_bar: compute a beta schedule tensor from a cosine, exp, or laplace alpha_bar transform function
